description: An Australian postal address. Stores codes only (region = ISO 3166-2:AU subdivision code; countryCode = "AU"). Self-describing via the required $kind property, which is also the discriminator when this appears inside the postal.address union. Property names deliberately mirror us-address rather than local terminology -- city holds what Australian addressing calls the suburb or locality, postalCode holds the postcode -- so consumers handle every postal.address variant with one uniform shape.

$kind.description: Self-identifies the data (cf. GraphQL __typename) and discriminates this variant inside the postal.address union. Resolves back to this schema.

city.description: Suburb or locality, e.g. "Fitzroy", "Surry Hills" -- Australian addressing's suburb line, held in the suite-uniform city property.

contexts.description: Free-text roles this address serves, e.g. ["home"], ["billing"], ["shipping"] (JSContact-style) -- WHERE this address is used.

geo.description: Optional GeoJSON Point for the address location.

postalCode.description: Four-digit Australian postcode. Format only -- not validated against the region. Region/postcode cross-check is deferred to consumers, the same trade us-address makes for ZIP codes.

preference.description: Rank among a person's addresses; 1 = most preferred (vCard PREF). Absent means unspecified -- do NOT treat missing as 100 (lowest). Consumers comparing preferences should ignore entries without a value.

region.description: ISO 3166-2:AU state or territory code, e.g. "VIC", "NSW".

street1.description: Primary delivery line, including unit/level where present, e.g. "Unit 5, 10 Smith St". 64 caps junk that downstream mail handlers reject, matching us-address.

title: Australian postal address
